T&T | Cyber: D&R | Analyst | Incident Response & Handling | Delhi

The Team
Deloitte helps organizations prevent cyberattacks and protect valuable assets. We believe in being secure, vigilant, and resilient—not only by looking at how to prevent and respond to attacks, but at how to manage cyber risk in a way that allows you to unleash new opportunities. Embed cyber risk at the start of strategy development for more effective management of information and technology risks. Learn more about      Cybersecurity
Your work profile
As a Consultant in our Cyber team, you will support incident response, threat hunting, compromise assessment, malware triage, and digital forensics engagements. You will work under the guidance of experienced team members to collect and review evidence, analyse security events, document findings, and contribute to clear, evidence-based investigation outputs.The role requires foundational knowledge of incident response processes, including triage, scoping, evidence collection, containment support, eradication, recovery, root cause analysis, and lessons learned. The individual should be comfortable learning in time-sensitive situations and collaborating with SOC, engineering, identity, cloud, and infrastructure teams.
Key Skills Required
Support incident response activities, including initial triage, evidence collection, event validation, scoping support, containment tracking, recovery support, and post-incident documentation.
Review security events using evidence sources such as EDR telemetry, SIEM alerts, Windows event logs, Sysmon, identity logs, cloud audit logs, network telemetry, mailbox artefacts, and SaaS evidence under appropriate guidance.
Assist in correlating available evidence to understand the source, impact, timeline, and potential scope of a security incident, and escalate findings to senior team members.
Support investigations into phishing, credential compromise, suspicious authentication, malware execution, persistence, privilege abuse, lateral movement, and ransomware-related activity.
Maintain accurate case notes, evidence trackers, investigation timelines, query records, and structured evidence trails to support technical analysis and reporting.
Support incident bridge calls and technical discussions by maintaining action trackers, capturing key decisions, and preparing concise investigation updates.
Collaborate with SOC, engineering, identity, cloud, and infrastructure teams to obtain evidence and support investigation activities.
Support incident response assessments, simulations, playbook reviews, and after-action documentation.
Contribute supporting evidence and analysis for root cause assessment, lessons learned, and resilience improvement recommendations.
Actively participate in training, knowledge-sharing, lab exercises, and feedback sessions to develop technical investigation capability.
Follow evidence-handling, confidentiality, documentation, and quality-review requirements throughout the engagement.
Prepare clear investigation notes, evidence summaries, timelines, indicator lists, and draft technical findings for review by senior team members.
Use investigation utilities such as CyberChef, Sysinternals, Wireshark, KAPE, Eric Zimmerman tools, Velociraptor, or comparable tools as appropriate to assigned tasks.
Run approved SIEM, EDR, and threat-hunting queries and document results accurately; assist with query refinement under guidance.
Support malware triage using file metadata, hashes, strings, sandbox results, process behaviour, persistence indicators, and identified network connections.
Perform basic forensic triage of Windows and Linux systems, including review of event logs, registry artefacts, prefetch, scheduled tasks, services, PowerShell logs, browser artefacts, and process execution evidence under guidance
Overall experience of 0 to 2 years in cybersecurity, including relevant internships, academic projects, lab work, SOC exposure, incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, malware analysis, or security monitoring.
Practical exposure to security monitoring or investigation through employment, internships, projects, labs, simulations, or academic work is preferred.
Foundational knowledge of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, DNS, networking, authentication, and common enterprise security concepts.
Familiarity with SIEM or EDR platforms such as QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, or equivalent is desirable.
Basic understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, cyber kill chain, common attacker techniques, and incident response lifecycle.
Awareness of evidence sources beyond dashboards, including endpoint artefacts, authentication logs, cloud logs, network evidence, and mailbox artefacts.
Awareness of SOAR technologies, incident response playbooks, case-management workflows, and ITSM tools is desirable.
Ability to work in time-sensitive situations with professionalism, curiosity, structured thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to seek guidance when required.
Ability to document observations objectively, distinguish confirmed findings from hypotheses, and maintain evidence traceability.
Familiarity with scripting or query languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, KQL, SPL, SQL, or regular expressions is desirable.
Basic knowledge of network concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP and HTTPS, common ports and protocols, proxies, firewalls, and packet capture analysis.
Basic understanding of malware concepts such as hashes, strings, static and dynamic analysis, sandboxing, droppers, loaders, and command-and-control activity.
Basic understanding of Windows event logs, PowerShell, Sysmon, processes, services, scheduled tasks, registry artefacts, and common persistence mechanisms.
Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree
Certifications like GCIH, GCFA, ECIH v2, CHFI, GCIA, SC-200, or equivalent are preferred.

Associate Analyst – Supply Chain Planning Systems (Kinaxis)
About Thermo Fisher Scientific
At Thermo Fisher Scientific, everything we do begins with our Mission — to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. As a global leader in serving science, we deliver innovative solutions that impact healthcare, life sciences, and research worldwide.
Our values —  Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement  — shape how we work together.
Role Overview
We are looking for a  curious, analytical graduate with a real interest in how supply chains work  to join our Supply Chain IT team as an  Associate Analyst supporting Kinaxis Maestro, our supply chain planning platform .
Kinaxis Maestro (formerly RapidResponse) is where our planners balance demand, supply, inventory, and capacity across Thermo Fisher's global network. When a plan is wrong or the system is unavailable, products that customers rely on for research, diagnostics, and therapies can be delayed. In this role, you will help keep that platform  reliable, accurate, and trusted by the planners who use it every day .
You will start by  learning planning processes and the system alongside experienced Kinaxis specialists , and then progressively take ownership of  production support, configuration changes, testing, and user enablement .
No prior Kinaxis or work experience is expected — we will train you.  What we need from you are strong fundamentals: logical thinking, comfort with data, clear communication, and the drive to learn a specialist platform in depth.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate who wants to build a career at the intersection of  supply chain planning, enterprise technology, data, and AI .
How You Will Grow in Your First Year
Months 0–3 | Learn:  Structured onboarding on supply chain planning fundamentals (demand, supply, inventory, S&OP) and Kinaxis Maestro basics; complete Kinaxis Learning Center training; shadow the support team on live tickets.
Months 3–6 | Contribute:  Resolve routine user queries and support tickets under guidance; build and modify simple worksheets, filters, and alerts; execute test scripts for enhancements and releases.
Months 6–12 | Own:  Independently handle defined categories of support tickets; analyze recurring issues and propose permanent fixes; support a small enhancement end-to-end, from requirement to deployment.
Key Responsibilities
Provide first- and second-line support to planners using Kinaxis Maestro — log, analyze, resolve or route issues, and track them through closure within agreed service levels.
Monitor daily data loads, scheduled jobs, and planning refreshes; flag failures and data gaps early to the right teams.
Learn and apply core planning concepts — demand planning, supply planning, master production scheduling, inventory and capacity planning, and S&OP.

Collaborate with ERP (SAP, Oracle JD Edwards, Oracle Cloud SCM) and integration teams to understand how data flows into and out of Kinaxis.
Create and maintain support runbooks, knowledge articles, user guides, and training material.
Follow change control, documentation, and compliance practices required in a regulated (GxP) life sciences environment.
Explore how  analytics, automation, and AI  can reduce repetitive support effort and help planners make faster, better decisions.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Industrial, Production, Mechanical, Computer Science, IT), Operations, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
Coursework, projects, or a strong interest in operations management, supply chain, or production planning.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving ability — comfortable breaking a messy problem into logical steps.

Basic SQL skills for querying and validating data.

Leadership or organizing experience in a technical club, student chapter, or college fest.

Competitive salary with annual performance-based bonus.

Structured onboarding, a 12-month learning plan, and a dedicated mentor for your first six months.
Sponsored Kinaxis Maestro training and certification through the Kinaxis Learning Center.

Employee wellness programs, on-campus recreational facilities, and mental health support.

We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team.
What you will be doing:
The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon.
You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features.
The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team.
You would assess and build C-model or RTL-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre-silicon environment.
What we need to see:
BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 0-2 years of experience
Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C++, Python.
Understanding of SOC and System Architecture.
Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt-engines, CPU, boot-devices, MMU/IOMMU function.
Operating System and Device-Driver concepts and ability to write no-OS test frameworks - i.e tests that run directly on the bare-metal SOC.
A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software.
Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle.
Way to stand out from the crowd:
Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks.
Exposure to Testbench architectures (C++ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches).
Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.

detail.description:
A Specialist within the Account Health Support team acts as the primary interface between Amazon and our third-party business partners (Sellers). We obsess over providing world-class support to Sellers, selling on the Amazon platform. We strive to predict the Seller's needs before they recognize they may have a problem, and provide solutions to help our third-party business partners better serve the customers.
Key job responsibilities
1. Seller Engagement and Relationship Management: Serve as the single, dedicated contact for a portfolio of sellers throughout their compliance journey. Build strong relationships by ensuring clear, accurate, and timely communication. Execute structured outreach plans, including proactive contacts, biweekly follow-ups, and pre-enforcement outreach. Educate sellers on compliance requirements and guide them through necessary documentation and actions.
2. Case Management and Documentation: Manage all seller interactions through a centralized mechanism to ensure complete visibility and consistency. Accurately log all actions, communications, and documents to maintain high data integrity and audit readiness. Monitor progress across all applicable legislations, ensuring timely updates and closure of cases.
3. Inbound Support and Regain Activities: Respond promptly to inbound requests via available channels, providing expert guidance. Support enforced sellers through targeted regain outreach and education, helping them return to compliant status quickly.

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS: English & German
PROCESS TYPE: Voice Process (Inbound and Outbound Calling)
SHIFT REQUIREMENTS: Rotational Shifts and Week Offs (should be flexible to work as per business requirements)

The AHS Specialist you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end compliance journey of assigned sellers under the AHS Dedicated Support model. detail.description:
Experience in e-commerce, quick commerce, or last-mile logistics.
Familiarity with fulfillment center or MFCs operations
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
•	Monitor in-store fulfillment operations (order acceptance, picking, packing, staging) and last-mile delivery (DP assignment, transit, delivery) in real time
•	Identify and resolve operational exceptions — delayed orders, capacity gaps, quality drops, connectivity issues, and delivery failures
•	Track key performance metrics (On-Time Performance, Delivery Success Rate, Pick Efficiency) and escalate deviations
•	Coordinate with field teams, logistics partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve issues within SLA
•	Manage Delivery Partner capacity — monitor acceptance rates, release additional slots, and escalate shortfalls
About the team
NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a specific arm which manages Amazon Fresh, SSD & Amazon Now (Quick commerce) businesses. GSF – Central Operations (GSF-CO), part of the Network Operations Center (NOC), acts as the Command-and-Control center for the GSF operations in IN, SG and MENA. Team supports multiple lines of businesses such as (a) Amazon Fresh – i. Ultra-Fast Fresh (UFF) & ii. Hybrid 3P; (b) Sub-Same Day (SSD) across last mile, first mile, distribution centers, Supply Chain and (c) Amazon Now AKA Project Tez which is the Quick Commerce arm of amazon.in. In Addition, GSF CO manages delivery operations of More Super and Hyper Market (MSM) located in T10+ cities, remotely, where the scope includes order assignment, exception monitoring, COD reconciliation and BTO Scans. Apart from IN, GSF CO also supports Fresh, SSD & Quick Commerce (QC) operations in AE & SG geographies.
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- •	Bachelor's degree in any discipline
- •	0–2 years of experience in operations, logistics, supply chain, or customer service
- •	Strong analytical skills with the ability to read and act on real-time data
- •	Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- •	Willingness to work rotational shifts including weekends and holidays
- •	Experience in e-commerce, quick commerce, or last-mile logistics
- •	Familiarity with fulfillment center or MFCs operations
- •	Exposure to real-time monitoring tools or Control tower environments
- •	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data visualization tools

detail.description:
Experience in e-commerce, quick commerce, or last-mile logistics.
Familiarity with fulfillment center or MFCs operations
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
•	Monitor in-store fulfillment operations (order acceptance, picking, packing, staging) and last-mile delivery (DP assignment, transit, delivery) in real time
•	Identify and resolve operational exceptions — delayed orders, capacity gaps, quality drops, connectivity issues, and delivery failures
•	Track key performance metrics (On-Time Performance, Delivery Success Rate, Pick Efficiency) and escalate deviations
•	Coordinate with field teams, logistics partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve issues within SLA
•	Manage Delivery Partner capacity — monitor acceptance rates, release additional slots, and escalate shortfalls
About the team
NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a specific arm which manages Amazon Fresh, SSD & Amazon Now (Quick commerce) businesses. GSF – Central Operations (GSF-CO), part of the Network Operations Center (NOC), acts as the Command-and-Control center for the GSF operations in IN, SG and MENA. Team supports multiple lines of businesses such as (a) Amazon Fresh – i. Ultra-Fast Fresh (UFF) & ii. Hybrid 3P; (b) Sub-Same Day (SSD) across last mile, first mile, distribution centers, Supply Chain and (c) Amazon Now AKA Project Tez which is the Quick Commerce arm of amazon.in. In Addition, GSF CO manages delivery operations of More Super and Hyper Market (MSM) located in T10+ cities, remotely, where the scope includes order assignment, exception monitoring, COD reconciliation and BTO Scans. Apart from IN, GSF CO also supports Fresh, SSD & Quick Commerce (QC) operations in AE & SG geographies.

A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional
Early Career Talent
When you join Amazon Web Services as a student or recent graduate, you’ll have the chance for your voice to be heard and amplified. That’s because our teams are looking to learn as much from you as you’ll learn from them. Whether you’re graduating with a high school or equivalent diploma, associate degree, bachelor’s degree, MBA, or PhD, we offer a range of early career opportunities across the globe.
About the team
Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs.

Our overall mission is simple: We want Amazon to be the place where our customers can find, discover and buy anything online. Whatever our customers want, we will find the means to deliver it. With your help, Amazon will continue to enable people to discover new worlds. This is your chance to make history. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build trust of our customers and sellers. Amazon hires the brightest minds, are you one of them?
Customer Trust and Partner Support (CTPS) aims to make Amazon the safest place to transact online. CTPS safeguards every financial transaction across all Amazon sites, while striving to ensure that these efforts are transparent to our legitimate customers. As such, CTPS designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimize risk and maximize trust in Amazon.com.
Job description:
Amazon is seeking for individuals who are dedicated, hardworking, analytical and results-oriented. Candidates will be responsible for a wide range of duties related to the investigation and elimination of online e-commerce risk. The position relies on an analytical mind, detailed investigation and excellent judgment. Productivity and quality assurance will be evaluated along with the overall contribution to the development of the department.
Key job responsibilities
• Communicate effectively via live video call with our customer base – third party sellers who want to sell on Amazon in its various marketplaces.
